name: Lunar Polar Water-Ice Endurance v1
description: A survival-weighted, full-chain benchmark on the anchor's Shackleton-de Gerlache world (scenarios/1-lunar-polar-ice-prospecting.md): the heterogeneous swarm must sustain the excavate -> haul -> extract -> purify -> store ISRU chain across a 30-day campaign spanning lunar night, under a fixed compute budget. A distinct task from the anchor: it drops the pure-prospecting metrics and ranks by nights_survived, so the primary leaderboard question is endurance and yield-per-energy, not discovery. Content is REUSED by hash from the anchor's published Hub artifacts (RM-P1-WORLDS-15 / RM-P1-FLEET-10 / RM-P1-PROSPECT-13) - see PROVENANCE.md. This scenario does not exercise the operational_targeting dual-use gate.

world.description: Shackleton-de Gerlache ridge, lunar south pole, version 0.4.0 - ships its horizon map, so the world resolves in ~3 s instead of re-deriving a 192-million-entry skyline from the packaged DEM on every load (astro-mine-worlds#46). Terrain and regolith rasters are byte-identical to the prior bundle; the PSR mask is now the spec-driven, validated one (|error| 0.0400 inside the 0.0500 budget, where the 0.1.0 world this pinned before was at 0.0586 - outside it).
